title: Fenthion Triggers Cardiac Dysfunction Through TLR4, HMGB1/RAGE, and NF-kappaB Pathways: An In Vivo and In Silico Assessment.
authors: Alzahrani, Fuad M; Otifi, Hassan M; Hayat, Muhammad Faisal; Alzahrani, Khalid J; Alsharif, Khalaf F
one_liner_zh: 该文研究杀虫剂Fenthion通过TLR4/HMGB1/NF-kB通路致心脏毒性的体内实验与分子对接/MD模拟，虽含蛋白互作模拟但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Fenthion (FTN) is a noxious insecticidal agent that has been reported to exert adverse impacts on the health of different organisms. The current investigation was conducted to evaluate the adverse impacts of FTN on cardiac tissues at different dose concentrations. Thirty-six albino rats were apportioned into four groups including the control, FTN (25 mg/kg), FTN (50 mg/kg), and FTN (100 mg/kg) treated group. Rats were treated orally for 28 days consecutively. It was revealed that the FTN (25, 50, and 100 mg/kg) intoxicated group showed high abundances of receptors for advanced glycation end products (RAGE), tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha), toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4), high mobility group box 1 (HMGB1), nuclear factor-kappa B (NF-kappaB), monocyte chemoattractant protein-1 (MCP-1), interleukin-6 (IL-6), cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2), and interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta) of mRNA in qRT-PCR analysis. Moreover, the abundances of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and malondialdehyde (MDA) were higher while the activities of catalase (CAT), glutathione peroxidase (GPx), glutathione reductase (GSR), heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1), superoxide dismutase (SOD), and contents of glutathione (GSH) were reduced after all the tested concentrations in enzyme activity analysis. FTN (100 mg/kg) exposure increased the concentrations of N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP), B-type natriuretic peptide (BNP), creatine phosphokinase (CPK), lactate dehydrogenase (LDH), creatine kinase-MB (CK-MB), troponin-T, and troponin-I in ELISA assessment. Furthermore, all the tested concentrations of FTN exposure promoted the levels of Caspase-9, Bax, and Caspase-3 while reducing Bcl-2 levels in ELISA analysis. Moreover, all the concentrations of FTN exposure dysregulated the normal anatomical structure of cardiac tissues. Finally, in silico investigations, including molecular docking and molecular dynamic simulation, were conducted to further support the cardiotoxic effects of FTN. These findings suggest that FTN interacts with the active sites of target proteins, potentially disrupting their normal functions and contributing to severe cardiotoxicity.
abstract_zh: 芬硫磷（FTN）是一种有害的杀虫剂，据报道对不同生物体的健康产生不良影响。本研究旨在评估不同剂量浓度下FTN对心脏组织的不良影响。将三十六只白化大鼠分为四组，包括对照组、FTN（25 mg/kg）处理组、FTN（50 mg/kg）处理组和FTN（100 mg/kg）处理组。大鼠连续口服处理28天。结果显示，在qRT-PCR分析中，FTN（25、50和100 mg/kg）中毒组表现出晚期糖基化终末产物受体（RAGE）、肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-alpha）、Toll样受体4（TLR4）、高迁移率族蛋白B1（HMGB1）、核因子-κB（NF-kappaB）、单核细胞趋化蛋白-1（MCP-1）、白细胞介素-6（IL-6）、环氧化酶-2（COX-2）和白细胞介素-1β（IL-1beta）的mRNA丰度升高。此外，在酶活性分析中，所有测试浓度下，活性氧（ROS）和丙二醛（MDA）的丰度升高，而过氧化氢酶（CAT）、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GPx）、谷胱甘肽还原酶（GSR）、血红素加氧酶-1（HO-1）、超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）的活性以及谷胱甘肽（GSH）的含量降低。在ELISA评估中，FTN（100 mg/kg）暴露增加了N末端前B型利钠肽（NT-proBNP）、B型利钠肽（BNP）、肌酸磷酸激酶（CPK）、乳酸脱氢酶（LDH）、肌酸激酶-MB（CK-MB）、肌钙蛋白-T和肌钙蛋白-I的浓度。此外，所有测试浓度的FTN暴露在ELISA分析中促进了Caspase-9、Bax和Caspase-3的水平，同时降低了Bcl-2的水平。而且，所有浓度的FTN暴露扰乱了心脏组织的正常解剖结构。最后，进行了包括分子对接和分子动力学模拟在内的计算机模拟研究，以进一步支持FTN的心脏毒性效应。这些发现表明，FTN与靶蛋白的活性位点相互作用，可能破坏其正常功能并导致严重的心脏毒性。
